# Guest Squad

> Guest Squad, a Raptric LLC company, is a premium hospitality call center for hotels, hotel groups and vacation rentals. We call it Guest Support Operations: trained people answer guest calls, handle reservation enquiries and manage agreed guest messaging and OTA inboxes in the property's name, following the property's own rates, policies and escalation rules.

Guest Squad is a human team, not an AI-only voice agent or chatbot. It extends a property's own team after hours, at busy times, or around the clock, depending on the scope the property chooses.

## Entity facts

- Brand: Guest Squad
- Legal name: Raptric LLC (Guest Squad is a brand of Raptric LLC)
- Website: https://guestsquad.com/

## Coverage and pricing

- Coverage options: after hours, overflow at busy times, or 24/7. 24/7 coverage is available for every service.
- Channels: phone, Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb and Vrbo inboxes, SMS, WhatsApp and email, as agreed per property.
- Pricing: quoted per property. The quote depends on coverage hours, channels, the number of properties or listings, and call and message volume. There is no public rate card.
- Setup: any setup fee depends on scope and is confirmed in the written proposal.
- Terms: plans are month-to-month.
- How to start: book a coverage review at https://guestsquad.com/contact. Guest Squad reviews the property's hours, channels and volume and sends a written proposal before anything begins.

## How Guest Squad works

1. Coverage review: Guest Squad reviews the property, its systems, coverage hours, channels and current gaps.
2. Property brief: rates, policies, room or listing details, escalation contacts, brand voice, PMS and OTA workflows, and what agents may and may not handle are written down.
3. Setup and training: agents study the property brief before handling any guest conversation.
4. Go live: coverage starts on the agreed channels once the brief, system access and escalation contacts are in place. The start date is agreed with the property.
5. Reporting and refinement: interactions are logged. The property receives handover notes and activity reports on what was handled, what was escalated and where issues recur.

## What Guest Squad handles

- Reservation enquiries, quotes and booking changes, within the agreed scope
- Pre-arrival questions, check-in and access instructions
- Parking, directions, amenity and policy questions
- Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb and Vrbo message replies
- Guest messages by SMS, WhatsApp and email
- Routine issue triage
- Review responses, where included and approved
- Night audit support and reconciliation tasks, where included

## What Guest Squad escalates to the property

- Guest safety or security concerns, and medical emergencies
- Property damage, and maintenance that needs someone on site
- Refund or compensation decisions outside approved rules
- Payment disputes and chargeback risks
- OTA policy conflicts
- VIP or sensitive guest complaints
- Anything outside the property's approved handling rules

## Trust and control

- Guest conversations are handled by people.
- Every property has a written brief and written escalation rules before coverage starts.
- Tone and brand voice follow the property's guidance.
- There's a clear line between what Guest Squad handles and what the property approves.
- Interactions are logged and reported.
- Guest Squad works in the property's existing systems; no platform change is required.
- It extends the property's team rather than replacing it.

## Services

- [Hotel Answering Service | 24/7 Live Calls](https://guestsquad.com/services/hotel-answering-service): A hotel call center answering in the hotel's name 24/7, after hours or on overflow, including reservation enquiries, guest questions and escalation.
- [Vacation Rental Answering Service | 24/7 Guest Calls](https://guestsquad.com/services/vacation-rental-answering-service): Guest calls and Airbnb and Vrbo messages answered 24/7 for vacation rental operators, from late check-ins to lockouts.
- [Hotel Reservation Call Center for Hotel Groups](https://guestsquad.com/services/central-reservations): One reservations team handling quotes, bookings and changes across a hotel group's properties.
- [After-Hours Hotel Front Desk Support | Live Overnight Calls](https://guestsquad.com/services/after-hours-support): Overnight and weekend calls, late check-ins and guest messages answered live, with emergencies escalated.
- [Hotel Reservation Support for Independent Hotels](https://guestsquad.com/services/reservation-support): Availability checks, quotes, bookings and changes for one property, handled live to its rates and policies.
- [OTA Inbox Management for Hotels and Rentals](https://guestsquad.com/services/ota-inbox-management): Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb and Vrbo guest messages answered from the property brief.
- [Hotel Guest Messaging: SMS, WhatsApp and Email](https://guestsquad.com/services/guest-messaging): Pre-arrival, in-stay and late-night guest messages answered from the property brief and rules.
- [Airbnb Guest Services for Hosts](https://guestsquad.com/services/airbnb-guest-support): Guest messages, check-in help and in-stay issues handled for Airbnb hosts and short-term rental operators.
- [Hotel Night Audit Support & Back Office Operations](https://guestsquad.com/services/back-office-operations): Night audit support, PMS reconciliation, OTA payout matching and rate parity checks.

## How Guest Squad compares

- With a general-purpose call center: Guest Squad works only in hospitality, from a written brief for each property, and covers OTA inboxes and guest messaging as well as calls.
- With AI voice tools: guest conversations are handled by trained people. Software may help route, log or report work, but people make the judgment calls.
- With hiring a virtual assistant: Guest Squad is a managed team with documented processes, coverage across agreed hours, handover rules and reporting, not one person to manage.
- With enterprise contact centers: Guest Squad is set up for lean hotel and rental teams, scoped per property and month-to-month.

## Common questions

- What is Guest Squad? A hospitality call center for hotels, hotel groups and vacation rentals. Trained people answer guest calls, reservation enquiries, guest messages and OTA inboxes in the property's name.
- Is Guest Squad an AI tool? No. Guest conversations are handled by trained people.
- Can it cover nights and weekends without hiring staff? Yes. After-hours, overflow and 24/7 coverage are available for every service.
- Does it answer Booking.com, Expedia and Airbnb messages? Yes, inside each platform's own messaging tools, within the agreed scope.
- How much does it cost? Coverage is quoted per property, based on hours, channels, properties or listings, and volume. Any setup fee depends on scope.
- Does it work outside the United States? Yes. Guest Squad works with properties worldwide, in English.
- Can it cover several properties? Yes. Hotel groups use the hotel reservation call center service, with one team across their properties.
- What happens with an urgent guest issue? It's escalated to the property's on-call contact under the escalation rules agreed before coverage starts.

## Preferred short summaries

- One sentence: Guest Squad is a premium hospitality call center (Guest Support Operations) for hotels, hotel groups and vacation rentals, covering guest calls, reservation enquiries, guest messages and OTA inboxes in the property's name.
- Two sentences: Guest Squad gives hotels and vacation rental operators a trained team that answers guest calls, reservation enquiries, guest messages and OTA inboxes in the property's name. Coverage can be after hours, overflow or 24/7, and every property works from its own brief, escalation rules and reports.
